text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Hosted API p95/p99 latency spike detected in us-west-1. Queue depth rising on hosted-request-queue. Autoscaler failing to provision GPUs (quota error). Golden metrics: p95 > 2.8s, p99 > 6.2s, error-rate +15%. Runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/queue-spike

sara_oncall: I'm on it — paging SRE. Observed sustained enqueue rate ~3x baseline for the last 4m. Any customer-facing impact yet?

jamie_sre: Confirmed. Some requests are timing out at 30s and being retried. Backend logs show repeated `quota_exceeded` from cloud provider when creating GPU nodes. Autoscaler logs: `failed to create node: quota exceeded (GPUs)`.

mike_ops: Which pool is targeted? Hosted-GPU-pool-usw1, burstable. Autoscaler attempted 14 nodes in last 6m then hit provider quota.

olivia_prod: Happening during a campaign window — may be traffic from one partner. I'm pulling customer list.

ben_qa: Seeing clients getting 429s and a few 504s. Frontend rate-shed kicked in for some routes, but backlog still growing.

jamie_sre: Immediate mitigation options: 1) Enable temporary circuit-breaker on hosted API to shed lowest-priority traffic. 2) Route eligible workloads to Dedicated (if accounts have it). 3) Rollback to smaller model (8k->4k) for non-critical routes. 4) Ask cloud for quota bump (slower). Which do we do first?

sara_oncall: Do 1) and 2) now. I'll flip circuit-breaker and get routing policy updated. Jamie, can you take autoscaler logs and try a graceful restart?

jamie_sre: Restarting autoscaler manager now. Command: ```kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/autoscaler-manager-usw1```

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Action logged: `restart_autoscaler` by jamie_sre at 6291234575

mike_ops: I pushed a temporary routing policy to divert low-priority traffic to fallback model-hosted-small-v2. Policy snippet: ```{"match": "client.priority<=10", "route": "model-hosted-small-v2"}```. Will monitor.

olivia_prod: Pushing list of flagged customers: partner-acme, partner-zen, internal-corp. Partner-acme accounts for ~42% of burst. Reached out to partner PM to ask for rate throttle.

ben_qa: Quick check: what does the circuit-breaker threshold look like? If we set aggressive thresholds we might cut into real customers.

sara_oncall: Circuit-breaker config I just applied (temporary): ```circuit_breaker: {queue_depth: 12000, enqueue_rate: 20000, drop_policy: "lowest_priority_first"}```. Effectively dropping non-logged-in, non-paid trial traffic.

jamie_sre: Autoscaler restart completed. But creation still failing with same `quota_exceeded`. Restart didn't change provider state. We need to stop trying to create more GPUs until quota bump or we free pool.

mike_ops: I'm evicting low-priority Dedicated burst nodes in eu-west to free regional quota and then we'll attempt cross-region allocation. Doing controlled drain on `dedicated-burst-eu1-*.`

incident-bot: :hourglass_flowing_sand: Action logged: `evict_low_priority_dedicated_nodes` by mike_ops at 6291234599

olivia_prod: PM from partner-acme responded — they can throttle by 50% for next 10m. They asked for a contact if degradation continues.

ben_qa: Metrics after circuit-breaker + routing change: p95 dropped from 2.8s -> 1.3s for paid customers, p99 down to 3.1s. Overall enqueue rate still high but backlog growth flattened. Errors for non-paid traffic up (expected).

sara_oncall: Good. Next: open emergency quota request with cloud (I opened ticket CLD-98765) and escalate to infra lead. Also documenting customer impact: partner-acme (~42% of burst), partner-zen (~15%), 8 smaller customers share rest. Estimated customer-facing error rate at peak ~12%.

jamie_sre: Note for postmortem: autoscaler should not keep spinning create attempts when provider returns permanent `quota_exceeded`. We'll add backoff/stop condition. I filed a follow-up: INFRA-3211.

mike_ops: Cross-region allocation in progress: attempting to spin nodes in aws-us-east-2 as fallback. If quota there available we'll route traffic via smart-routing to us-east edge.

incident-bot: :rotating_light: UPDATE: cross-region attempt partially successful, created 3 nodes in us-east-2. Starting model transfers; expect warmup ~45s.

olivia_prod: Customer comms draft (for partners): "We're experiencing degraded performance due to a sudden traffic surge; we've applied emergency mitigations and are working to fully restore service. We'll update in 30m." Approve?

sara_oncall: Approve, send now to partners prioritized by impact. Include contact for pager duty escalation.

ben_qa: Monitoring: p95 for paid stays ~1.2-1.5s, p99 trending down to ~2.8s as nodes come online. Queue depth reduced from 18k -> 9k in last 10m.

jamie_sre: Autoscaler follow-up items while stabilizing: - add backoff on quota error - add circuit-breaker trigger to avoid node churn - better metric for create-fail rate.

mike_ops: Noted. Also adding temporary enforcement to token bucket at edge to limit per-client burst to 8 req/s for the next 20m. Implementing now.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: MITIGATION SUMMARY: circuit-breaker enabled, low-priority routing to smaller model, autoscaler restarted, limited cross-region fallback, partner throttling agreement, temporary per-client rate-limits. Queue depth halved, p99 improving. Actions documented: INFRA-3211, CLD-98765, follow-up postmortem assigned to jamie_sre.

olivia_prod: Sending customer comms now. Notifying sales & account teams.

sara_oncall: Handoff to night oncall in 30m. @jamie_sre please include a short blurb for the handoff channel with current state and open actions.

jamie_sre: Will do. Hand-off note: "system stable-ish, p99 ~2.5s, queue depth ~7.8k, autoscaler create-fail due to cloud GPU quota — cross-region nodes added; follow-ups INFRA-3211 and quota ticket CLD-98765. If queue re-growth observed, escalate to infra lead and re-enable stricter circuit-breaker."

mike_ops: :thumbsup: adding logs and commands used to the incident doc.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Thread closed for now at 6291234623 (status: mitigated; monitoring)."
